name: What is the difference between a minor update and a full bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a minor update and a full bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A minor update typically focuses on cosmetic changes without altering the layout or major plumbing/electrical systems. This might include repainting, replacing a vanity, upgrading light fixtures, or installing new tile over existing surfaces. A full bathroom renovation, conversely, involves significant changes, often including reconfiguring the layout, moving plumbing lines, replacing the tub/shower, toilet, vanity, and flooring. It may also involve updating electrical systems, addressing structural issues, and selecting entirely new finishes and fixtures.
acceptedAnswer.description: A minor update changes cosmetics without altering layout or major systems. A full renovation involves significant changes to layout, plumbing, electrical, and all fixtures.
